status: Draft. Becomes frozen when committed with the tag 'rubric-frozen' and before the judge is first run. Thresholds were written before any lecture was scored.
scale: Each criterion is scored 0, 1 or 2 per 1,000-word window. Level 2 requires the specific behaviour named, not general competence. Reported as a profile per criterion, with no single total.

judge.sees: one window, no title, course or institution

evidence_rule: Every score needs a verbatim quote from the window. A score whose quote is not found in the window is discarded and counted.

flags.name: Suspected content error
flags.rule: Any statement that appears technically or factually wrong. Reported with a quote and is never scored. Every flag is checked by hand.

levels.0: Ideas are stated without explanation, or the explanation is hard to follow.
levels.1: Main ideas are explained in plain steps.
levels.2: Explained in plain steps and restated or checked in different words at least once.

levels.0: No indication of where the talk is going or how parts connect.
levels.1: Some structure is stated (a plan, a transition or a summary).
levels.2: Structure is stated at the start of the segment and linked back to it at the end.

levels.0: Technical terms are used without being defined.
levels.1: Most new terms are defined when first used.
levels.2: Every new term is defined when first used and tied to something already known.
A concrete example plus a statement of what it shows or where it stops applying.

levels.0: Frequent broken sentences that hinder understanding.
levels.1: Occasional restarts or fragments that do not hinder understanding.
levels.2: Sentences are complete and well formed apart from ordinary speech restarts.
